# ToggleButton { #anylumino.ToggleButton }

```python
ToggleButton(
    value=False,
    description='',
    indent=True,
    icon='',
    icon_src='',
    icon_size='s',
    disabled=False,
    variant='',
    tooltip='',
    quiet=False,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Boolean toggle-button control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type     | Description                                                                                                        | Default   |
|-------------|----------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| value       | optional | Initial value and synced Python value.                                                                             | `False`   |
| description | optional | Label shown above the control.                                                                                     | `''`      |
| disabled    | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled.                                                                              | `False`   |
| indent      | optional | Whether checkbox labels are indented.                                                                              | `True`    |
| icon        | optional | Spectrum workflow icon name, for example ``'AddContent'`` or ``'HelpCircle'``.                                     | `''`      |
| icon_src    | optional | Custom icon image URL or data URI for ``sp-icon``.                                                                 | `''`      |
| icon_size   | optional | Spectrum icon size such as ``'s'``, ``'m'``, ``'l'``, ``'xl'``, or ``'xxl'``.                                      | `'s'`     |
| variant     | optional | Spectrum visual variant such as ``'accent'``, ``'primary'``, ``'negative'``, ``'positive'``, or ``'informative'``. | `''`      |
| tooltip     | optional | Hover text.                                                                                                        | `''`      |
| quiet       | optional | Whether to use Spectrum's quiet visual treatment.                                                                  | `False`   |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [control_kind](#anylumino.ToggleButton.control_kind) | A trait for unicode strings. |
